en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abu Al Jaroud, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, said, ‘

I heard him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> saying that the Muslims were exhausted in Khyber, so were quick with regards to their animals. So Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> ordered them with restraint of the cooking-pots (from these animals), and did not say that these are Prohibited, and that was a preservation upon the animals’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from abu al-Jarud who has said the following: “I once heard abu Ja’far, Alayhi al-Salam, saying,

’Muslims during the days of Khaybar faced difficulties and they rushed their stumpers. The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, commanded that the cooking pots must be emptied (of cooking donkey flesh) and did not say it is unlawful for food. It was to preserve stumpers.’”
